programmes.title: Individual & Performance Coaching
programmes.label: 1:1 + SMALL GROUP
programmes.caption: Personalised coaching for players who want to reach the next level.
programmes.eyebrow: Personalised coaching. Individual growth. Real opportunities.
programmes.intro: Personalised 1:1 football and athlete development with experienced, qualified coaches. Since 2019 we’ve worked with hundreds of players across the region, and individual development is one of our fastest-growing areas.
programmes.audience: Engaged, motivated players who want to strengthen specific areas of their game, prepare for a season or take the next step.

features.title: Built around you
features.text: Every session is tailored to the player: technical ability, decision-making, tactical understanding, confidence and overall performance. Available all year round.

features.title: Highly qualified coaches
features.text: Football operations are led by our Director, an OFC A Licence coach who oversees the academy and first team at a large membership club. Our leading coaches hold OFC B Licences.

features.title: Real milestones
features.text: We help players progress beyond the environments where they started: towards overseas university opportunities, high school first teams, senior men’s debuts and higher levels of competition.

facts: Football expertise, grassroots to high performance

programmes.title: 2027 Athlete Academy
programmes.label: 2027 INTAKE
programmes.caption: Development across all six of our sports, alongside school and club sport.
programmes.intro: For ambitious young athletes in football, futsal, basketball, hockey, touch rugby and cricket who are ready to work hard, learn and keep developing. A structured programme that supports your journey alongside your existing school and club environment.
programmes.audience: Young athletes across all six of our sports with the ambition to develop and the commitment to put in the work.

features.title: Develop the whole athlete
features.text: A programme bringing together technical development, athletic performance, performance psychology and athlete education.

features.title: A plan for your progress
features.text: Small-group development, individual planning and regular feedback help you understand what to work on next.

features.title: Support along the way
features.text: Coaching and ongoing guidance that work alongside your school and club commitments.

facts: Football, futsal, basketball, hockey, touch rugby & cricket
programmes.enquiryGuidance: Tell us your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. Our team will be in touch to discuss your journey and the next steps.

programmes.title: Early Years & Fundamentals
programmes.label: PRESCHOOLS · AGES 2–5
programmes.caption: Little PlayKicks: play-based movement and ball skills for preschools.
programmes.eyebrow: Little PlayKicks · Where early learning meets active play
programmes.intro: Since 2020 we’ve worked with preschools and Montessori centres across Christchurch. What began as football has grown into Little PlayKicks: a complete motor-skills, multi-sport introduction that builds movement, confidence and a lifelong love of being active.
programmes.audience: Preschools, Montessori and early learning centres, and educators looking to introduce active learning through sport.

features.title: Mini Movers · Ages 2–3
features.text: A warm, nurturing introduction to movement and play: balance, simple instructions and sensory play.

features.title: PlayKickers · Ages 3–4
features.text: More structured activities blending football skills and all-sport coordination: kicking, dribbling, throwing, catching and agility.

features.title: Little Legends · Ages 4–5
features.text: A confident step towards school sport and clubs: ball control, gameplay basics, teamwork and independence.

programmes.label: SCHOOLS & COLLEGES
programmes.caption: The right coaches and programmes, built around your school.
programmes.eyebrow: The right coaches. The right programmes.

features.title: Coach recruitment
features.text: We recruit the coaches, you focus on your students. Flexible support for individual teams, extracurricular activities and seasonal needs.

features.title: Programme delivery
features.text: From regular training to structured development programmes, we deliver engaging, organised sport that fits your school’s goals.

features.title: Every level
features.text: From primary school fundamentals to first XI competition and university performance, coaching tailored to every age and ambition.

programmes.title: Active Age Programme
programmes.label: RETIREMENT VILLAGES
programmes.caption: Low-impact movement for mobility, balance and confidence.
programmes.eyebrow: Movement. Mind. Confidence. At every stage of life.
programmes.intro: Active Age is our movement programme for older adults in retirement villages. It adapts the proven methods behind our preschool programme to maintain mobility, coordination, confidence and cognitive function through enjoyable, low-impact activity.
programmes.audience: Retirement villages and elderly care providers looking for engagement and respite programmes that support residents’ health, independence and wellbeing.

features.text: Low-impact, age-appropriate activities led by Proteus-trained coaches, with chair-based options and minimal equipment or space needed.

features.title: Body and mind
features.text: Balance and fall-prevention, hand–eye and foot–eye coordination, and reaction-based games that keep the mind sharp.

features.title: Social and enjoyable

faq.question: Which programme is right for us?
faq.answer: Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.

faq.question: Do you offer more than football?
faq.answer: Yes. Football is at our core, and our coaches also deliver futsal, basketball, hockey, touch rugby and cricket, with netball and other sports in our holiday programmes. Get in touch with your sport and the coaching you need.

faq.question: How big is the Proteus team?
faq.answer: Nearly 60 coaches delivered programmes across Christchurch in the first quarter of 2026, supporting hundreds of athletes every week across schools, clubs, early learning centres and community programmes.

faq.question: How do I express interest in the 2027 Academy?
faq.answer: Email info@proteus.nz for any of our six Academy sports. Include your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. The team will be in touch to discuss the next steps.

faq.question: Where can I find holiday dates and registration details?
faq.answer: Contact oliver@proteus.nz for upcoming holiday programmes, locations and registration information. Programme details vary, so check the information for the specific camp before booking.

faq.question: Can Proteus help our organisation beyond coaching?
faq.answer: Yes. Alongside coaching we offer operational support and sports business capability: strategic and governance support, sports management and recruitment, sports marketing and promotion, and organisational development to help you build sustainable programmes.

faq.question: What is it like to coach with Proteus?
faq.answer: You join a network of 60+ coaches with quick onboarding into sessions, reliable fortnightly payments and a strong focus on support and retention. We help coaches gain experience, develop professionally and find pathways into the industry.

faq.question: How can our school or club work with Proteus?
faq.answer: Contact patrick@proteus.nz with your organisation, the sport or activity, the group you want to support and your goals. We can discuss coaching and programme options that fit your needs.
